Pancham

Fighting

Kalos · Generation 6

Pancham is a Fighting-type Playful Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 0.6 m tall and weighs 8 kg. It evolves into Pangoro. Its highest base stat is Attack (82), with a base stat total of 348.
